note: Canonical Qwen3-TTS Base clone knobs when the ref already carries Seed-VC (or other) prosody that must survive. Used by accent pipelines and dual outline audio. Do not use x_vector_only=true: it discards ref_code and keeps only timbre.

qwen.ref_text_source: whisper-medium of the reference WAV (or accurate sidecar / REF_TEXT.txt when the WAV speaks that phrase)

instruct.en: Speak English clearly with natural emotional colour, audible dynamics, and a slightly slower unhurried pace. Finish every word and final consonant fully — do not cut off or trail into silence mid-syllable. Match the feeling of the line; do not sound flat or monotone.
instruct.es: Speak Spanish clearly with natural emotional colour, audible dynamics, and a slightly slower unhurried pace. Keep only a light L1 colour — do not exaggerate the accent. Finish every word and final consonant fully — do not cut off mid-syllable. Match the feeling of the line; do not sound flat, monotone, or rushed.
instruct.note: EN keeps curated L1 accent as-is. ES softens accent slightly. Both ask for full phrase completion. Per-line [QwenInstruct] is prefixed with expressivenessPrefix.

expressivenessPrefix.en: Deliver with natural emotional colour and clear dynamics; do not flatten the line. Complete every syllable through the end of the sentence.
expressivenessPrefix.es: Deliver with natural emotional colour and clear dynamics; do not flatten the line. Soften the accent; keep identity without heavy L1 colour. Complete every syllable through the end of the sentence.

dialogueSpeed.note: DISABLED for quality: post-synth time_stretch (librosa) sounded bad. Prefer slower source refs (re-run native-L1 Qwen ICL with slow instruct / optional Seed-VC length_adjust>1). Keep 1.0 unless experimenting.

seedVcV2.note: Native-L1 paint: source = voice-donors/native/{lang}, target = selected character timbre. convert_style=true pulls accent toward the target and washes L1.
